# TaxAct

> > TaxAct provides tax preparation software for individuals, businesses, and tax professionals, supporting forms including 1040, Schedule C, Schedule A, Form 1120, and state returns.

TaxAct offers desktop and online tax filing solutions for sole proprietors, C-corporations, S-corporations, and individual taxpayers. The platform includes professional editions with pay-per-return options, extensive IRS form support, and comprehensive guidance on deductions including qualified business income (QBI), itemized deductions, and charitable contributions.

## Key Topics

- Form 1040 and 1040-SR
- Schedule C (sole proprietor business income)
- Schedule A (itemized deductions)
- Schedule F (farm income)
- Form 1120 and 1120-S (corporate returns)
- Qualified Business Income (QBI) deduction
- Self-employment tax
- Form 1099-NEC and 1099-K
- Charitable contributions and Form 8283
- Business deductions
- State tax returns
- Desktop and online tax software
- TaxAct Professional editions
- IRS compliance and filing
- Medical and itemized deductions

## Business Tax Software

- [Sole Proprietor Business Taxes | TaxAct](https://www.taxact.com/business-taxes/download/sole-proprietor): TaxAct Business 1040 Schedule C/F for sole proprietor tax filing
- [C Corporation State Tax Filing Software | File 1120 Tax Return](https://www.taxact.com/business-taxes/download/c-corporation-state): TaxAct Business 1120 state edition for C-corporation state returns
- [Business Pay-Per-Return Tax Software | Features & Benefits](https://www.taxact.com/professional/products/federal-enterprise): TaxAct Professional Business Pay-Per-Return multi-user edition

## Professional Tax Software

- [Security and Identity Authentication to Keep Your Tax Data Secure](https://www.taxact.com/professional/security): TaxAct Professional security features and two-factor authentication

## Business Tax Forms and Schedules

- [Independent Contractors](https://www.taxact.com/support/21727/2024/independent-contractors): Schedule C self-employment reporting for Form 1099-NEC contractors
- [Schedule K (Form 1120-S) - Purpose](https://www.taxact.com/support/980/2024/schedule-k-form-1120-s-purpose): Schedule K Form 1120-S purpose for S-corporation shareholder income
- [Form 1041 - Beneficiary's Portion of Total Distributions](https://www.taxact.com/support/24390/2024/form-1041-beneficiarys-portion-of-total-distributions): Form 1041 beneficiary distribution allocation using Schedule K-1

## Itemized Deductions and Schedule A

- [Cash Contributions Limitations Worksheet](https://www.taxact.com/support/1050/2024/cash-contributions-limitations-worksheet): Schedule A charitable contribution limits and carryover worksheet
- [Charitable - Frequent Flyer Miles](https://www.taxact.com/support/1053/2024/charitable-frequent-flyer-miles): IRS guidance on deducting donated frequent flyer miles (Form 8283)
- [Charitable - Cash Contributions - Foreign Exchange Student](https://www.taxact.com/support/15285/2024/charitable-cash-contributions-foreign-exchange-student): Schedule A deduction for foreign exchange student hosting expenses
- [Medical Expenses - Nursing Home for Alzheimer's Patients](https://www.taxact.com/support/15117/2024/medical-expenses-nursing-home-for-alzheimers-patients): IRS Publication 502 guidance on deducting Alzheimer's nursing home care
- [Sales Tax - More Than Five States](https://www.taxact.com/support/1339/2024/sales-tax-more-than-five-states): Schedule A sales tax deduction for multiple states calculation

## Individual Tax Forms and Credits

- [Form 5329 - Not Included With Return](https://www.taxact.com/support/21902/2024/form-5329-not-included-with-return): Form 5329 retirement plan penalties filing with Form 1040
- [Form 1099-C - Credit Information Not Required](https://www.taxact.com/support/21303/2024/form-1099-c-credit-information-not-required): Form 1099-C cancellation of debt creditor information entry
- [Repayment of Income - IRC 1341 Credit](https://www.taxact.com/support/14410/2024/repayment-of-income-irc-1341-credit): IRC 1341 credit for income repayment on Schedule 3 Form 1040
- [Form 1310 - Name On Refund Check Needs To Be Changed](https://www.taxact.com/support/1218/2024/form-1310-name-on-refund-check-needs-to-be-changed): Form 1310 for changing deceased taxpayer refund check name
- [Individual Shared Responsibility Provision - Income](https://www.taxact.com/support/24100/2024/individual-shared-responsibility-provision-income): ACA individual shared responsibility and health coverage requirements

## State Tax Returns

- [California - Form 568 Limited Liability Company Return of Income](https://www.taxact.com/support/20758/2024/california-form-568-limited-liability-company-return-of-income): California Form 568 for single-member LLC disregarded entity filing
- [New Hampshire - Form DP-10](https://www.taxact.com/support/1477/2024/new-hampshire-form-dp-10): New Hampshire Form DP-10 for interest and dividends tax filing
